constraints.definition: CHECK (((valid_to IS NULL) OR (valid_from IS NULL) OR (valid_to >= valid_from)))
CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['confirmed'::text, 'retired'::text])) OR ((reviewed_by IS NOT NULL) AND (reviewed_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['scheduled'::text, 'needs_review'::text])) OR (scheduled_for IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((decision_id IS NOT NULL) OR proxy OR (source <> 'gate'::text)))

CHECK (((approval_status <> 'approved'::text) OR ((approved_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_hash = content_hash) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL) AND (selected_cta IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK ((((base_score IS NULL) OR ((base_score >= (0)::numeric) AND (base_score <= (100)::numeric))) AND ((adjusted_score IS NULL) OR ((adjusted_score >= (0)::numeric) AND (adjusted_score <= (100)::numeric)))))
CHECK (((approval_status <> 'approved'::text) OR ((approved_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_hash = content_hash) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK (((approval_status <> 'approved'::text) OR ((manifest_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_hash IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_hash = manifest_hash) AND (approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (approved_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((disposition <> 'reframe'::text) OR ((reframe IS NOT NULL) AND (central_point_kept IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((embedding IS NULL) OR (embedding_model IS NOT NULL)))
FOREIGN KEY (moment_id) REFERENCES key_moments(moment_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
CHECK ((num_nonnulls(transcript_id, angle_id, brief_id, pack_id, asset_id, calendar_entry_id) <= 1))
CHECK (((completed_units IS NULL) OR (total_units IS NULL) OR (completed_units <= total_units)))
CHECK ((((completed_units IS NULL) OR (completed_units >= 0)) AND ((total_units IS NULL) OR (total_units >= 0))))
